title: Florida AI Laws

reading.body:
Florida's only AI-related law is a resolution recognizing the Tampa Bay area as a cybersecurity and artificial intelligence innovation region, not a rule that regulates AI.

The measure, S1816, passed on 2026-03-12. It designates CyberBay, acknowledges the state's cybersecurity preparedness, and affirms public-private collaboration on cyber readiness and economic resilience. It creates no obligations, no compliance duties, and no enforcement mechanism. It is a statement of intent, and the data covers exactly one such item.

For AI infrastructure, the significance is geographic rather than legal. A named innovation region in the Tampa Bay area signals where the state wants data center, power, and cybersecurity investment to concentrate. That matters because compute buildout follows where permitting, land, and grid capacity are politically welcomed. But a recognition resolution does not grant those things. It does not change siting rules, utility regulation, or interconnection queues.

The data does not say whether Florida has considered or rejected other AI bills, what the region's power or transmission capacity is, or whether any incentive follows the designation. One law, and a non-binding one, is the entire Florida record here. Readers should treat this as a signal of stated priorities, not as evidence of AI regulation or of the grid conditions that would actually constrain compute in the state.

Enacted AI laws in Florida

1 law this site judged relevant to AI, newest first, each read from its enrolled text.

  • S1816: CyberBay passed 2026-03-12

    The Florida Senate recognizes CyberBay as a cybersecurity and artificial intelligence innovation region within the Tampa Bay area, acknowledges Florida's national leadership in cybersecurity preparedness and digital defense, and affirms the importance of continued public-private collaboration to strengthen cyber readiness and economic resilience.

How this page is kept

This page is generated from the enacted laws this site tracks for Florida. When the legislature passes another AI-related bill, it appears here the night the bill's text is read. The full 50-state picture is at State AI Laws.
